capabilities: insert LaTeX templates from a right-sidebar equation palette
fill empty equation slots with a live preview and cursor linking
build matrices up to 6x6 and cases with a size grid and bracket styles
adapt operator and quantifier templates to the cursor context
disambiguation: Despite the name, it has nothing to do with Obsidian Canvas; it is an equation palette for writing LaTeX in the editor.
extras: Notes keep plain $…$/$$…$$ so they work without the plugin; requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer and is desktop-first; beta versions install via BRAT; research notes live in docs/research.md; not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Writing LaTeX math requires memorizing commands, which blocks beginners and people who only occasionally need an equation.
summary: Point-and-click sidebar palette that builds and edits LaTeX math equations in the editor.
